option_relations.rationale: Infectious mononucleosis with neurological complications is a broader category that encompasses EBV meningoencephalitis, cerebral infarction, and subdural hemorrhage, which are all neurological complications of EBV infection.
Viral meningitis is a broader category of inflammation of the meninges caused by a virus. EBV meningoencephalitis is a specific type of viral meningoencephalitis, which includes meningitis.
Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) meningoencephalitis is the core diagnosis described in the leaf, with cerebral infarction and subdural hemorrhage being complications of this condition.

Epstein-Barr virus encephalitis is a broader term for inflammation of the brain due to EBV. The leaf specifies meningoencephalitis, which includes both meningitis and encephalitis, and also details specific complications.
